from.place: ## Proof, affine case: the sentence identifying H^q(C_et,G_m) with H^q(Cbar_et,j_*G_m) from the Leray spectral sequence

title: Low-degree Leray comparison for an open immersion
statement: Let j:C \to Cbar be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion] and let F be an abelian sheaf on the small etale site of C [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. If (R^q j_*F)_x=0 for every geometric point x of Cbar [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] and q=1,2, then the natural Leray edge map H^q(Cbar_et,j_*F) \to H^q(C_et,F) in etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], formed using the direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], is an isomorphism for q=0,1,2.

source.place: Discussion preceding Tag 03RM; low-degree consequence of the Leray spectral sequence after vanishing of R^1j_*F and R^2j_*F
